name: 90017 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90017 (Los Angeles) has 365 nonprofit organizations. 157 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 136 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90017 (Los Angeles) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 90017 (Los Angeles) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 6.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 86 organizations here; 12% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
